Class ResponseHandler

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.ResponseHandler
public final class ResponseHandler extends Object
Deserializes and maps EquinixResponse bodies: singleton/list/paginated JSON handling, raw string/byte/map handling, header extraction, and the JSON-to-model mapping helpers that turn deserialized Pages into user-facing PaginatedLists.

Split out of the former monolithic Utils class; see RequestAssembler, ParameterMapper and SerializationHelper for the request-side helpers.

Author:
ianjones

    • handlePaginatedListResponse

      public static <J> Page<J> handlePaginatedListResponse(EquinixResponse<?> equinixResponse, EquinixRequest<?> equinixRequest) throws EquinixClientException
      Deserializes a paginated list/search response into a Page of raw JSON items and attaches the request/response pair for lazy paging. The request may be typed over the public model or the JSON model — only the page's item type <J> matters here.
      Type Parameters:
      J - the page's item (JSON model) type
      Throws:
      EquinixClientException - if any.

    • toPaginatedList

      public static <T,S> PaginatedList<T> toPaginatedList(Page<S> page, Pageable<T> serviceClient, BiFunction<? super S, ? super Pageable<T>, ? extends T> objectMapper)
      Builds a fully-populated PaginatedList from a deserialized Page in one step: maps each JSON item to its model wrapper and attaches the page's request/response/pagination for lazy paging. Replaces the repeated map-then-reconstruct boilerplate in resource clients.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the model type
      S - the JSON type
      Parameters:
      page - the deserialized page (carries items + associated request/response + pagination)
      serviceClient - the paging client used to fetch subsequent pages
      objectMapper - maps a JSON item to its model wrapper
      Returns:
      a paginated list ready for next()/loadAll()

      Builds a fully-populated PaginatedFilteredList from a deserialized Page in one step (the POST-search counterpart to toPaginatedList(Page, Pageable, BiFunction)).
      Type Parameters:

      Parameters:
